title: Volvo FH powder coated FUPS Road Train Bullbar #34
description: FH series Volvo, FUPS compliant hi-tensile powder coated aluminium Bullbar. A wide colour range to choose from. This style is only 138KG with Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate. Radar compatible. Flip over reversible Road Train signs. Dual tow pins and "Roo" cutters for maximum protection for the headlights. Combination Indicator repeater, daylight running lights in the outer uprights. Driving light mounts to customer requirements.
